_about: The pillar chamber (Theo's cog room). Room Review round 25 (2026-10-14, Josh): CHAMBNEW/1-12 a real uplight under each spotlight the art paints on the four curved walls (three a wall, at Josh's marks); CHAMBNEW/13 the room's mood -- the darkness painted into its textures made real in a dark fog, as CORICORI, kept lighter to fit this paler room.
_lights: CHAMBNEW/1-12: twelve uplights, more than the eight placed lights a room can have, so they are WALL WASHES ('wash': true -- steady spotlights with no shadow, up to 16 a room, graphics card only). Each at Josh's mark, 8 units out from the wall along its normal and 5 above the floor (y -60; the marks were 8-20 up -- one height so the twelve match), aimed up and 20 degrees into the wall, so the beam starts at the floor and climbs it, brightest low and fading by ~120 up the way the painted light does; a warm cream like the art's. They light the room by bounce too (gi).

lights.name: glow on the pillar's west face (Room Review CHAMBNEW/14)
lights._about: Round 27, Josh: 'Subtle light source here, no torch, just a blob light with bounce lighting' -- an all-round glow 15 out from the mark (-170.62, 24.3, -12.66), the painted-light finder's glow recipe, in the uplights' colour; the room's gi carries its bounce.

lights.name: glow on the pillar's east face (Room Review CHAMBNEW/15)
lights._about: Round 27: as CHAMBNEW/14, 15 out from the mark (-305.79, 25.99, -10.13).

lights.name: light column over the creature (Room Review CHAMBNEW/16)
lights._about: Round 27, Josh: 'make sure the creature here is subtly illuminated. Not from his body, but just ensure there is a subtle column of light in this area, fading as it rises higher' -- a narrow uplight from just over the floor at the mark (-244.49, -65.24, 10.38), straight up, no shadow: it lights the creature from beneath and shows as a column in the room's black air, fading over its range as it rises.

gi._about: Bounced light from the twelve uplights, as the other rooms; ambient 0.7 (a paler room than the caves)

volume._about: CHAMBNEW/13 (Josh: 'mood lighting ... matching the darkness of the textures with dark mist like ... the cori cori room but fit the overall tone and lighting of this room'): CORICORI's black air and painted darkness, about half as thick (a paler room) -- thicker black where the ORIGINAL art is painted dark (the walls' upper reaches over the painted spots, the floor's dark corners).

artLight._about: CHAMBNEW/13: as MINEHEAD and WELLROOM -- the ORIGINAL art's painted light and shade, per texel, shades the room level and the bounce (the uplights untouched), so the art's dark reads as real darkness and its painted spots as lit wall
